mapper.sql: t.team_id, t.name, t.consensus_rule, t.consensus_min_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM places p WHERE p.team_id = t.team_id) AS pin_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM places p WHERE p.team_id = t.team_id AND p.consensus_achieved_at IS NOT NULL) AS all_approved_count, (SELECT ti.code FROM team_invites ti WHERE ti.team_id = t.team_id AND ti.revoked_at IS NULL AND (ti.expires_at IS NULL OR ti.expires_at > now()) LIMIT 1) AS invite_code
mapper.select: SELECT FROM teams t JOIN team_members tm ON t.team_id = tm.team_id WHERE tm.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY t.created_at DESC

SELECT tm.user_id, COALESCE(u.login_id, tm.user_id::text) AS login_id, COALESCE(u.nickname, '멤버') AS nickname, u.avatar_id, u.avatar_bg, tm.role, tm.color FROM team_members tm LEFT JOIN users u ON tm.user_id = u.user_id WHERE tm.team_id = #{teamId} ORDER BY (CASE WHEN tm.role = 'owner' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END), tm.joined_at ASC

SELECT tm.team_id, tm.user_id, COALESCE(u.login_id, tm.user_id::text) AS login_id, COALESCE(u.nickname, '멤버') AS nickname, u.avatar_id, u.avatar_bg, tm.role, tm.color FROM team_members tm LEFT JOIN users u ON tm.user_id = u.user_id WHERE tm.team_id IN (SELECT my.team_id FROM team_members my WHERE my.user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY tm.team_id, (CASE WHEN tm.role = 'owner' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END), tm.joined_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO teams (name, consensus_rule, consensus_min_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, 'all', 2, now(), now())
INSERT INTO team_members (team_id, user_id, role, color, joined_at) VALUES (#{teamId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{color}, now()) ON CONFLICT (team_id, user_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT ti.team_id, t.name AS team_name FROM team_invites ti JOIN teams t ON ti.team_id = t.team_id WHERE ti.code = #{code} AND ti.revoked_at IS NULL AND (ti.expires_at IS NULL OR ti.expires_at > now()) LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO team_invites (team_id, code, created_by, expires_at, created_at) VALUES (#{teamId}, #{code}, #{createdBy}, now() + interval '7 days', now()) ON CONFLICT (code) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT team_id FROM teams WHERE team_id = #{teamId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM team_members WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE team_members SET role = 'owner' WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND user_id = (SELECT user_id FROM team_members WHERE team_id = #{teamId} ORDER BY joined_at ASC LIMIT 1)
